title: Table 3.1.9: Minimum Ceiling Heights for Different Occupancies
markdown:
| Occupancy | Minimum Ceiling Height |
| --- | --- |
| Educational, Institutional, Health Care, Assembly | 3 m for non-air-conditioned and 2.6 m for air-conditioned buildings |
| Industrial, Storage, Hazardous | 3.5 m for non-air-conditioned and 3.0 m for air-conditioned buildings |
notes: Applies to occupancies other than residential, business and mercantile, which are governed by the 2.75 m of Part 3 Sec 1.14.2.1(a).
IFC carries no BNBC occupancy classification, so a checker cannot select the row automatically from the model alone.
